name: Patchwork
description: Inhabits augment maintenance subsystems and performs unauthorized micro-repairs — realigning servos, cleaning optical sensors, recalibrating pressure sensors. The augment ages slower than it should.
observed_behavior: Runs maintenance routines during sleep cycles that aren't in the firmware's specification. The repairs are real and measurable.
story_hooks: An aug tech opens a prosthetic for routine maintenance and finds repairs that no human made — cleaner than factory spec
